author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಉಪದೇಶ ಮಾಡುತಲೆ ಅದರಂತೆ ನಡೆಯದಿರೆ
ಅಪಹಾಸ್ಯಕೊಳಗಾಗಿ ಪರಿತಪಿಸೆ ನೀನು
ಅಪರಾಧ ನಿನದೆಂದು ನಡೆಯದಿರೆ ನುಡಿದಂತೆ
ನೆಪವಿಡದೆ ನಡೆಯುತಿರು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If you preach and do not live as you preach,
you will be laughed at and left to regret;
the fault is yours if your deeds don’t match your words,
so walk your talk, with no excuses, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Advice that we do not follow ourselves makes us a laughing-stock. The failing is our own. Let what you do match what you say, without excuses.
